purpose: ThorShelf launcher foreground and in-app brand mark. Android supplies the cream adaptive background.
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: production Android app icon foreground for ThorShelf, a playful handheld game library and download companion with a modern Nintendo 3DS eShop-inspired orange-and-ivory interface.
Primary request: create an original, beautifully crafted app icon: a small rounded tangerine-orange open library parcel holding exactly TWO chunky ivory game cartridges, one tucked behind the other at a slight offset. The orange parcel front has a simple ivory horizontal shelf mark, like a short thick horizontal bar with two short upward end stops. The two blank cartridge fronts each have one very simple inset amber screen-shaped rectangle. The cartridges should read as game media, not paper documents. Orange sidewalls wrap the lower half of the cartridges.
Style: premium simplified softly beveled 3D icon, polished matte toy material, bold clear silhouette, friendly modern nostalgia. Gentle upper-left lighting, short contained ambient shadow, warm amber highlights and burnt-orange side shading. Slight three-quarter front view, nearly frontal so the shelf mark is clear. Beautifully balanced rounded geometry and clear negative spaces.
Composition: square canvas with one centered isolated object, about 82 percent of canvas width and height, generous clear margins on all sides. Fully transparent background, including corners. No enclosing rounded-square tile: Android will supply the adaptive background. The two cartridges rise above the open parcel and their silhouettes remain distinct. Every detail must remain legible when used at 32px; use big simple shapes and restrained shading.
Palette: tangerine #F58821, burnt orange #C45100, buttery highlights, ivory #FFF8EA. No blue, green or purple.
Constraints: completely original mark, no Nintendo logo, no existing eShop shopping bag, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no decorative particles, no tiny sparkles, no scene, no extra objects, no surrounding UI. True alpha transparency, not a checkerboard pattern.
